title: 11 Indian Crew Members Injured as Vessel Struck by Projectile in Strait of Hormuz
detail: Eleven Indian crew members were injured when their vessel was struck by a projectile while transiting the Strait of Hormuz. India condemned the attack, adding a new South Asian diplomatic dimension to the maritime conflict zone. The incident highlights the expanding human cost of the Hormuz security crisis beyond the Gulf states, with crew members from non-regional nations now directly affected by the escalating interdiction campaign.
